create_challenge_submission_from_predict: create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file from prediction results using the CLI
create_is2re_submission_from_trajectorie: create an IS2RE challenge submission file from trajectory files in a directory using --is2re-relaxations
create_is2re_submission_from_hybrid: create an IS2RE challenge submission file from S2EF NPZ prediction files using --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid
run_write_is2re_relaxations: run write_is2re_relaxations to extract energies from .traj files or hybrid NPZ predictions into a submission file
run_write_predictions: run write_predictions to convert an NPZ results file into a challenge submission format with challenge_ prefixed keys
